usedFor: Wbiztool sends messages through your Wbiztool account, including files with “Send PDF File With Text on WhatsApp”.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Send Advance Whatapp Message” in Wbiztool
bestTemplate.why: The action sends a customized transactional message, so a reply can follow an incoming message.

watchOut: “Send Advance Whatapp Message” reaches someone outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
